content_addressing_shared_with.name: capacity-attest
content_addressing_shared_with.note: Same rail-neutral content-addressing (sha256 of canonical JSON of the content fields) as the Base and BSV rails. XRP-specific parts (ed25519 signature envelope, XRPL classic-address encoding) are isolated behind the rail adapter.

external_attestation.raw_claim_sha256: FILL: sha256:<hex of the served claim.json bytes>

verifier.note: Verifies an ed25519 XRPL signature; the claim carries the payer public key which must derive to buyerAddress (XRPL classic r-address).

settlement.chain_reference_note: XRPL mainnet. Disambiguated by the tx existing on the XRP Ledger (verify via any XRPL explorer / public JSON-RPC).

asm_mapping.current_outcome_schema_limit: OutcomeReceipt v0.1-draft cannot type a non-fiat XRP settlement or external attestation reference without an extension mapping.

verified: raw claim bytes match the pinned digest
claim content recomputes to claimId (sha256 of canonical content)
ed25519 signature verifies under the payer public key, which derives to buyerAddress
the Payment delivered drops from payer to payee
not_independently_proven: historical use of ASM for the paid call
